Package classification

Class Classifier

java.lang.Object
classification.Classifier
public class Classifier extends Object
Classifies handwriting graphs into PRINT_BLOCK, CURSIVE, or MIXED. Trained GNN (GNNClassifier) using W1.csv and W2.csv weights. Rule-based classifier triggered automatically if GNN fails.
